rows.en:
No… I'll protect Akira myself.

Besides, even if we stay with you, Jiro, the danger of being targeted by DARK and Shadow won't change. And besides…
And besides?

We have to find Misao and Hiroshi, whom you met, Jiro…

That's what Akira wants, too.
All riiight, Akira… We caught a big fish! Come on, let's eat.
What's wrong, Akira…
I don't want to run away anymore!
Akira…

I can't do anything! I can't swim, and I've never caught a fish!

Because if all you ever do is run away, you can't do anything… I don't want to run away anymore!
Akira… The day will surely come when you won't have to run anymore! No, I'll make sure it does!
When? When will that day come?
Trust me! Soon, for sure, I promise!
Akira…

I hate this!

I… I even hate my own body now!

I wish this secret on my back would just disappear! As long as I have this, they'll keep coming after me forever!
Akira!
Disappear! I wish this secret would just disappear!

Take me somewhere far away! I want to live in peace somewhere DARK and Shadow can't reach!

Please… take me away! Brother Jiro!

I understand, Akira…

But there's no place on this Earth where you can escape from DARK and Shadow! The only way is to fight and defeat them! So please, wait a little longer!

I'll beat them, I promise!
Ah… Bijinder!

Ohohohohoho…

Taaah!

Bijinder…

I don't want to kill you… With my skills, it's an imperfect Conscience Circuit, but I did the very best I could!

Your body already has a Conscience Circuit!

Bijinder, the rest is up to your own will. I don't want you as my enemy! Bijinder!

Zero-One…

Whatever you do, in the end I'm an evil android born in Shadow…

I am an android built to kill you…
You still don't understand? Then I won't say any more! Here I come!
Zero-One, fight me!

Brother Ichiro! Don't kill Bijinder!

If you talk to her more, she'll understand, won't she? Save Bijinder… Bijinder isn't a bad guy!
Bijinder! Can't you hear what Akira is saying?
Out of my way!
Akira is standing up for you!
Out of my way! Get out of my way! If you don't move… my Bijinder Laser will burn you to a crisp.
Don't lie, Bijinder! What is it shining in your eyes right now?

You… are the only android who can shed tears!

If you just make up your mind, you can break away from Shadow.
Silence!
Look out! Taaah!
I won't hold back this time! Here I come!
Come on, Zero-One!
Hahaha… Bijinder, finish him! Do it!
Bijinder Laser!
Uoh… Bijinder, you… don't tell me you mean to betray us!?

You fool… letting them fit you with a Conscience Circuit…

I'll redo all of Bijinder's memory wiring! First, I'll smash that core of hers! I'll wreck the core Zero-One tinkered with!

Now, be a good girl…
Bijinder, you…
Shadow Knight! I won't do as you say!

Nngh… So you'd defy even me, Bijinder!?

You are a Shadow android! That's why you instinctively obey my orders… Bijinder!
Uuugh…
Jiro, take care of Rieko!
Come on, Rieko!
Don't let them escape! After them!
Heh heh heh… Kikaider! Think you can beat the immortal me?
DARK's Destruction Squad and Shadow! I won't let you do as you please any longer!
Hmph, fool! I'll take care of you all at once!

Hahaha… How's that, Bijinder?

An imperfect Conscience Circuit that Zero-One stuck in you is nothing but worthless junk!

I'll make you an even more powerful devil of an android! Unless we remove that Conscience Circuit, you'll be a defective android your whole life.

I don't care if I'm defective!

I'm… not Shadow anymore! I'll never be one of you!

Bijinder!

I'll teach you exactly what it means to betray Shadow!

Hahaha…
Bijinder, are you all right?
I really am… a half-baked android after all.

No, that's not true!

As long as you hold firm to the resolve not to give in to Shadow, you'll never go back to being an evil android again!

Bijinder! You've already broken away from Shadow, and done it well! Have confidence in yourself!
Heeey, everyone… has anyone seen Mari?

Taki… I think you'd better forget about her.

She'll never appear before you again…

No, I'm going to find her! I will, for sure…

Whoa, I can't just stand around here… She might be getting attacked by some evil organization somewhere!
That Taki… He's fallen for you.
Not for me… The one Taki fell for is a woman called Mari.
But you are Mari! Why not just tell Taki that you're Mari?

Taki… no, nobody could ever love a Shadow android!

If Taki found out that the Mari he loves really looks like this… it would break his heart.
But…
The form of Mari, the first time a human man ever loved me… I want to leave it be!
Besides, an android… must never be loved by a human!
Bijinder…
I… will never appear before Taki as Mari again.
I… understand that feeling very well too.
Bijinder…
Heh heh heh… I'm immortal! Now… what will you do next?
Uoooooh… Th-that's impossible! I'm… immortal… Uwah!

Hmm… That's strange…

We should be seeing ostriches and monkeys about now, shouldn't we?
You don't have to force yourself! Brother Ichiro!

Force myself!?

Why would you say that?
Because… you brought me here to cheer me up, didn't you?

Hahaha… That's not it!

Even I want to take it easy once in a while, you know.

All right, let me turn up my hearing a little… We might hear some beautiful wild birds.
Brother Ichiro…
The beautiful girl Mari who appeared before Ichiro and Jiro was Bijinder, an assassin android sent by Shadow.
At the sight of Mari suffering between the hearts of an angel and a devil, and at Shadow plotting evil by exploiting it, the Kikaider brothers felt an indescribable rage…
Hey! Are you all right!? Damn, how could this happen!
Hey! Are you all right!? Damn, how could this happen!

U11644: Akira asks Ichiro not to kill Bijinder; "she" for Bijinder (female android, glossary).
U11650: 嘸一 read as 唯一 "the only".
U11658: Shadow Knight speaks to the captured Bijinder; U11659 suggests she resists.
U11667: [HERO2] confronts Kaimen Green and Shadow; speaker placeholder.
U11687: [HERO4] relates to Bijinder (cf. B0143 U11432, she says she is not human).
U11691: Ichiro looking for ostriches and monkeys - likely a safari park; kept literal.
U11699/U11700: context of who is hurt is in the next batch.
omissions_kept: U11689: Kaimen Green's "what will you do next?" addressed to the Kikaider brothers (implied).
